text: Jorge - dad passed Sat. funeral prob end of next wk, Fri tbc. send card + ask if he needs anything
Amara - knee op went ok, crutches 6 wks. hates being stuck in. bring her the jigsaw thing
Obi made redundant @ the bank, last day end of the month. weirdly upbeat, wants to retrain as an electrician
Caroline & Luis split up. she's kept the flat in Leith, he's moved back to his mum's. C not great tbh
Lior's son Noah in hosp w/ appendicitis since Tues. out tomorrow hopefully. check in w/ Lior Thurs
chiropodist next Wed 10:40. pick up repeat prescription before

Chiara - mum diagnosed w/ early dementia. moving her to a care home sometime in the spring. C v stressed, juggling work + visits + her own kids, and her brother's no help, lives in Dubai. mum keeps asking for C's dad who died yrs ago, that's the hardest bit. care home viewings next Tues + Thurs. don't forget to ring her this weekend, maybe offer to go to one of the viewings w/ her
Lin's cat Biscuit put to sleep yesterday. 14 yrs. she's gutted
Aurelio - back surgery postponed again, now 'early March maybe'. fed up. coeliac btw so no flapjacks
Adaeze - grandma's 90th was meant to be next Sat, called off bc grandma's got shingles. Ada sounds worried
Kemal + Yara - their dog Pepper went missing Sun, found Mon night @ allotments. all fine now
Kaito Nakamura (Kai) - starts chemo sometime next wk. said not to make a fuss. maybe just text Mon, keep it light
need to: post Arturo's sympathy card, return library bks, ring garage re MOT. all before Fri
Jakub - wife Isabel broke wrist skiing. she's off work till after Christmas. he's doing school runs + all the cooking lol
Imani nervous abt her biopsy results, due 'in a fortnight'. hates waiting. Don't forget to message her the day before
funeral for Divya's uncle @ the crem Thurs 2pm. I'm driving her + her sister Zoe. dark suit to dry cleaners
Elijah's leaving do Fri - his whole team got cut. drinks @ the Crown from 6. he's got interviews lined up for next month
Noah - got the all clear!! scan Tues. tell Ethan before he hears it from someone else
Bogdan's mum v unwell, he's flying to Bucharest tmrw, back 'whenever'. covering his Sat shift. text him Sun to see how she is
Angela - divorce finalised last wk. weirdly relieved. off to Lisbon w/ her sister sometime over the summer
Malik - broke his collarbone at 5 a side Sun. no driving 6 wks. offered lifts to physio Mon + Thurs
Emre still struggling since his brother died in June. quiet on the group chat. I should take him for a pint next wk, no agenda
Zhang - daughter Lin Wang has glandular fever, off uni the rest of term. Zhang worried she'll fall behind
Blessing's dad had a mini stroke Weds. stable, in hosp a few more days. she's sleeping at the ward. Remind me to drop food round Sat
Ryan & Jasmine - wedding's off. he's moved out end of Sept. Jas taking it better than him apparently. don't mention it @ Kemal's bbq
dentist sometime next month - book it. also flu jab
Jasmine - granddad's funeral in Galway next Thurs, she's flying out Tues. I'm feeding her cat Mochi while away. key under pot
Jorge (Jorgito) - sister Caroline Reyes starts IVF early Jan. he's nervous for her. keep schtum
Amara asked how Obi's job hunt going. 2nd interview @ Siemens fri apparently!! wish him luck thurs night
Luis - mum's hip replacement end of Nov. he's taking 2 wks off to look after her. likes crime podcasts, send recs
Lior - back from shiva, v tired. dad was 81. said thank you for flowers. call her in a fortnight or so, not before
Chiara mentioned Aurelio's being made redundant - consultation meeting sometime next wk. he hasn't said anything to me so don't bring it up. just check in casually after
Adaeze - mum home from hosp tmrw after the gallbladder op. Ada wants to cook but can't cook lol. jollof recipe from Blessing?
Kaito's chemo round 2 Mon. pale but cheerful. loves those Japanese whisky miniatures - xmas present idea
Kemal - hand in plaster (DIY, ladder, don't ask). ok but can't work, he's self employed, worried abt money
Imani - biopsy all clear!!! celebratory dinner next Sat, her treat. booked @ Dishoom 7:30
Isabel's dad died Sun night. very sudden, heart. funeral prob next Fri or the Mon after. Jakub says she's numb. must send flowers + card, and offer to have the kids one evening this wk
Divya - started new job @ Barts Mon after the redundancy in summer. loving it. ask in a couple wks how she's finding the night shifts

Elijah - mum's breast cancer back, chemo starts after Christmas. he's moving back home for a bit, early Jan, to help his dad w/ hospital runs. his work said he can go remote till March. struggling but pretending not to - kept making jokes then went v quiet. loves Arsenal, maybe tickets for when he's back? text him this wk + again before he goes
Zoe's toddler has hand foot and mouth. nursery closed to him till Thurs. Zoe on zero sleep

Bogdan's mum passed this morning. 67. he's still in Romania, funeral Thurs there. sent msg. organise card from the team + collection, by Weds. he's off for at least 2 wks after, prob longer, needs to sort her flat + paperwork out there. his partner Yara staying here w/ the kids. offer Yara help w/ school pickups too
cancel gym Thurs, physio instead. knee

Ethan - girlfriend Angela left him last wk, out of nowhere. staying on my sofa till end of the month while he finds a room. not eating much, keeps checking her insta. I'm cooking Fri, his fave lasagne. his mum rang me to ask how he is, which was a bit weird. need to ask Ryan if his spare room's still free from Nov
Malik - collarbone healing, back at work next Mon on light duties. said thanks for the lifts
Emre came to the pub!! talked abt his brother a bit. planting a tree for him in the spring w/ their mum. I should ask if I can help
Zhang's wife - hysterectomy Thurs wk. Zhang v anxious, hasn't slept. their son Jakub flying in from Kraków for it
Blessing - dad home!! walking w/ a frame. physio twice a wk. she's back at work Mon. bring the Tupperware back
Ryan - 'fine' re breakup but drinking a lot. Jasmine says same. call him sometime this wk, maybe suggest climbing Sat
Caroline - knee replacement 'sometime in the new year', waiting list. hates hospitals. gardening on hold, misses it
Arturo's dog Rolo had a lump removed Fri, benign. Arturo celebrating w/ a curry lol. Rolo in a cone, v sorry for himself
Mrs Walsh next door - husband taken in by ambulance last night. chest pains. she's at the hospital, I've got their spare key. pop round tmrw a.m. + feed the hens

Jorge - funeral was lovely apparently, packed. he's back at work next wk but going to take Fridays off till Christmas. sorting dad's house w/ his brother Luis over the winter, prob selling in the spring. Luis wants to keep the boat, Jorge doesn't, bit of tension. Jorge's into woodwork, might take dad's tools. ask how it's going sometime mid Nov
Lin Murphy - redundancy consultation 'imminent', whole dept. she's applying elsewhere. good at data stuff, ask Kai if his place hiring
Amara - physio says 3 more months on the knee, so no hiking till Easter-ish. gutted abt the Peru trip, moved it to the autumn

Uncle Aurelio - Nonna Rossi in hospice now. days not wks prob. whole family going down Sat. Chiara asked me to keep weekend free in case, she might need me to mind the dog. Aurelio holding it together for everyone but Chiara says he cried on the phone. Nonna loved the opera, they're playing her Puccini. ring Chiara Fri evening
Obi - last day Fri, leaving drinks were cancelled (nobody in the mood). starts electrician course in Jan. wants a decent tool bag - gift?

Adaeze's partner Kemal had a seizure @ work Mon, first ever. tests next wk. driving licence suspended 6 months, which is a nightmare as he drives for work. both shaken. Ada says he's in denial, keeps saying it was just stress. they've got their anniversary trip to Cornwall end of Nov, might cancel. offer lifts to the neurology appt, whenever it is. also check if Ada's ok
shopping list: lemsip, oat milk, birthday card for Jas, bin bags

Imani's mum - hip fracture, fell in the garden Tues. op tomorrow. Imani's driving up to Leeds tonight, back sometime next wk, depends how the op goes. her brother Malik can't get time off so it's all on her. she sounded exhausted. cat sitting Pip meanwhile. remember Pip's on special food (kidney thing) + needs his tablet in the morning. text Imani tomorrow eve to see how the op went

Noah - dad's funeral next Friday. wants me there. he's doing a reading, terrified, never spoken in public. hasn't picked the poem yet, asked me for ideas - something not too religious, his dad was a fisherman. mum's being amazing apparently. text him the night before + send poem suggestions by Weds
